name: Fools
overview: Scripture reveals that fools are characterized by a rejection of God and wisdom, as seen in Psalms 14:1 where the fool denies God's existence and engages in corrupt acts. Proverbs highlights that fools despise wisdom and instruction, delight in mischief, and trust in their own understanding rather than counsel. Their speech leads to destruction, and it is wise to avoid their company, as Proverbs 14:7 advises departing from those who lack knowledge. Ultimately, the way of a fool is marked by folly that brings shame and separation from the fear of the Lord, which is the foundation of true knowledge.
